description: Stream Presence Launchpad readiness check of a public A2A Agent Card: schema validity, signature presence/validity, endpoint liveness (read-only probe — no task is sent), description/skills completeness, public contact route. Returns structured per-check findings with a specific fix for every failure — an unreachable card gets a fix, not a badge. Read-only; public https URLs only.

card_url.description: Public https URL of the Agent Card (/.well-known/agent-card.json)

title: Check an Agent Card (Launchpad readiness)
